verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI evidence is Fieldwork, whose AI agents collect, validate, and package compliance evidence from your systems. That is AI processing of your data, but not clearly insights or suggestions surfaced to the user. The MCP server lets an external assistant act on workspace data, but those insights come from outside the product, and the one-click secure baseline is a static recommendation, not AI-generated. Missing for 10: documented in-product AI-generated insights or recommendations from workspace data, an AI assistant or chat inside the Oneleet UI, clarity on whether Fieldwork is part of the core platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
